scope: Baseline of five then-selected old sprites, independently compared with actual selected internal V2 portraits before any new wave5 atlas selection. Historical finding is not a claim about a subsequently installed corrected atlas.

findings.incarnation: Kemet: The Devoured Sun — original-project current selected V2 portrait (2026)
observed: Older atlas has a cropped ivory bodice and exposed midriff, long smooth dark hair, curved head ornament, no khopesh.
Selected V2 instead has a continuous draped ivory wrap from chest through waist, short gold-ornamented textured braids, blue/gold collar, right-hand bronze khopesh and left-palm cyan balance.

limitations: Baseline discrepancy observed before any new wave5 sprite selection; once installed, the new selected asset must be assessed separately.
Only the actual original portrait is internal identity authority; historical atlas is comparison-only, not an independent source.
No perfect1:1 certification or foreign official-franchise source qualification inferred.
